stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation never reached READY_TO_MODEL or any equivalent final modeling/final answer state; it degenerated into repeated low-value maximum-limit questions and then incomplete/empty questions. All hidden slots are P2, so there are no unresolved P0/P1 slots.

summary: The agent recovered some Process II utilization and Model A minimum-production information, but missed the minimum profit target and Model B minimum production slot, and only partially probed whether Process I time must be exactly 150 hours. It then repeated low-value maximum-limit questions and ended without a clear ready-to-model or final-answer state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.
